Artifact, installed app, live provider, live Science, SSH server, signing, notarization, and public release behavior are NOT-RUN.

fetch and validate the upstream model catalog when no acceptable cache exists

after upstream 401 attempt guarded OAuth refresh only for the observed auth generation
stop and reap only a scratch Gateway; formal Gateway continues serving

matching cache bytes may not be committed

reject either open runtime journal before effects
when disabling stop only confirmed Codex runtime
recheck both journals and commit experimental flag

begin mutation lease
reject either open runtime journal before effects

recheck both journals and commit network setting

recheck expected profile ids and preview fingerprint

stop all managed runtime
secure writer rechecks both journals
atomically publish the user-selected export
write the rolling config backup
attempt v2 config publication and latch committed or uncertain outcomes
exit zero on committed downgrade or exit one on post-publish uncertainty

wait for local picker outside global lifecycle
acquire short typed host-bridge mutation lease
claim matching healthy typed host receipt
atomically install package files
attempt OPERON attach/readback under the same lease
report file commit separately from attachment/load verification

ordered_effects: MCP tool returns an authenticated host-access request contract for one external request.json publication
during Gateway startup validate the private bridge directory/token/context and acquire the nonblocking host lock
recover every valid orphan .processing file into a terminal interrupted response

publish best-effort accepted and heartbeat status

for uninstall confirm bundle scope or detach then quarantine the exact CSSwitch-owned package
publish one immutable final response then clear processing and transient status

update process-local Science identity and return a typed repair outcome

registered_surface.reason: Changes only profile name/notes; its config read/update can first migrate legacy config, while ordinary CRUD remains excluded from runtime operation plans.
